assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: complete production background for an interactive office simulation. Transform the supplied pixel-art office floor into an exceptionally photorealistic high-resolution architectural visualization, physically based offline render, 1632 x 1056 or same exact 17:11 aspect ratio, overhead oblique orthographic camera EXACTLY matching input. This is a pixel-position-locked art replacement: preserve the exact floorplan, image boundaries, camera projection, wall footprint, ALL openings and doors, ALL 17 desk locations and chair centers, conference table, kitchenette and floor occupancy. Every object must stay at the same relative coordinates and size as the reference. Do not rotate the floorplan or use an isometric diamond; walls remain horizontal/vertical on the image. No people. No UI or labels. Transform green pixel carpet into fine warm gray woven commercial carpet with subtle tile seams, desks into realistic pale natural oak desktops on graphite metal frames, chairs into black ergonomic fabric swivel chairs, monitors into slim contemporary dark widescreen monitors (screens exactly where original screen rectangles are). Conference table warm walnut with soft taupe upholstered chairs. Pale warm plaster walls with crisp white skirting; internal upper room partitions can be smoked glass within their existing footprints. Existing windows admit soft late-afternoon daylight, believable soft contact shadows, subtle reflections, realistic wood grain, glass, fabric and brushed metal. Kitchenette at bottom right becomes realistic oak cabinetry, stainless refrigerator and sink, modern espresso machine, dark neutral vending machine and magazines. Fine leaf-detailed living plants exactly at existing plant locations. Restrained high-end contemporary office photography, natural proportions, warm and inviting, no cartoon, no pixel edges, no outlines, no giant decorative new objects in corridors. Keep the composition absolutely registered to the input, fill the entire canvas with the same office boundaries without added margins. Replace ALL pixel artwork with realistic material detailing. Image is used directly beneath moving characters with existing collision coordinates: exact registration matters more than artistic freedom.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Production asset: transparent-background character sprite atlas for a realistic office simulator. Create ONE 5-column by 3-row STRICT UNIFORM GRID, exactly 15 SEPARATE full-body photorealistic adult office employees, one person centered inside each equal cell. Canvas 1920x1536 (5:4 ratio), each cell 384x512. GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, no checkerboard, no floor, no labels, no text, no dividers. Every person must fit completely in their own cell, heads aligned 8% below cell top and soles at 94% of cell height, no overlap or crop. Camera elevated 25 degrees looking slightly down at full body, ALL PEOPLE FACE CAMERA, orthographic 85mm look, relaxed neutral standing with arms slightly separate, feet slightly apart, natural realistic human proportions (7.5 heads tall), realistic faces/hands/shoes, detailed fabrics, soft daylight from upper left. Exact reading order: Row1: 1 middle-aged clean-shaven dark-haired man in charcoal business suit, white shirt and burgundy tie; 2 tall slim brown-haired young man in pale blue shirt, navy tie and charcoal trousers; 3 young woman with wavy auburn hair wearing cream blouse, sage cardigan and charcoal pencil skirt; 4 middle-aged man with short center-parted brown hair, wire glasses, mustard shirt, dark tie and brown trousers; 5 heavyset balding man in pale blue shirt, navy tie and black trousers. Row2: 1 petite blonde woman with straight hair in dove-gray fitted cardigan and black pencil skirt; 2 Latino middle-aged man with short black hair in plum shirt and charcoal trousers; 3 older stocky Black man with moustache wearing dark brown business suit and cream shirt; 4 middle-aged curvy woman with curly brown hair, glasses, lavender cardigan and navy skirt; 5 clean-shaven brown-haired man wearing light green shirt, striped tie, beige chinos. Row3: 1 young South Asian woman with long dark hair in dusty rose blouse and dark trousers; 2 young slim dark-haired man in charcoal shirt and black trousers; 3 middle-aged pale man with receding ginger hair, beige shirt and muted brown trousers; 4 older man with receding gray hair in olive shirt and charcoal trousers; 5 middle-aged woman with shoulder-length red hair in muted rust blouse and dark skirt. Refined believable everyday business clothing. No caricatures, no pixel art, no illustrations, no cartoon heads. Consistent scale, position, overhead viewing angle and lighting across all 15 grid cells. The people will be extracted by exact equal grid cells for game sprites.
assets.refinement: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact 15-person atlas. Remove ALL background pixels, gradients, glow and shadows outside the people, leaving GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA everywhere except the 15 people. A PNG cutout sprite atlas for compositing in a game, actual transparency, NOT a colored studio background, NOT a checkerboard image. Preserve every person's appearance, detailed face, clothing, body, shoes, pose, scale, and exact position unchanged. Preserve exact canvas dimensions 1536 x 1024 and the 5-column by 3-row arrangement. All 15 full-body people must remain intact. Only remove the background. No added text, no floor, no gray boxes.

assets.prompt: Production character sprite atlas, edit the supplied 15-person reference. Show these SAME EXACT 15 adults viewed FROM BEHIND, keeping each person's identity, hair, clothing, build, shoes, relative height, scale and exact cell positions. All now face straight AWAY from camera, see backs of heads and clothing. Same elevated 25 degree camera looking slightly down, same soft daylight. FIVE COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, one full-body person per cell, exact canvas 1536x1024. Original reading order Michael Jim Pam Dwight Kevin / Angela Oscar Stanley Phyllis Andy / Kelly Ryan Toby Creed Meredith. Strict equal cell grid, each figure centered horizontally, head 7% below top of cell, shoes 96% down each cell, every person stays within their cell. Critical: isolated cutout figures on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND for game compositing. NO studio backdrop, no gradients or halos outside silhouettes, no colored background, no ground, no shadow outside figures, no checkerboard pixels. Realistic human proportions and photographic details, no cartoon, no text. Relaxed standing arms beside body, feet slightly apart. These back-facing figures will animate office workers facing their monitors.

Production character sprite atlas: recreate these SAME EXACT 15 office adults all turned 90 degrees so they FACE IMAGE RIGHT, full-body RIGHT SIDE PROFILE. Preserve each identity, hair, clothes, build, footwear, relative size and grid location. FIVE COLUMNS by THREE ROWS exact 1536x1024 canvas, equal cells. Reading order Michael Jim Pam Dwight Kevin / Angela Oscar Stanley Phyllis Andy / Kelly Ryan Toby Creed Meredith. Camera elevated 25 degrees looking slightly down, every full person contained in own cell, head near 7% cell height, soles near96%, horizontally centered. Anatomically realistic standing profile, no exaggerated heads. Soft upper-left daylight matched to reference. Critical: GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND, cutout PNG sprite sheet, NO studio background, NO gray gradient, NO halos or outside shadows, NO checkerboard pixels, NO floor, NO text, NO cell dividers. Photorealistic natural detailed faces and fabric. All subjects looking straight to the right, arms relaxed beside body. This is for directly compositing isolated people over an office floor, so no background may remain.

Use case: precise-object-edit, production office game character sprite atlas. Keep the SAME 15 people, identical clothes, hair and proportions and exact FIVE-COLUMN THREE-ROW order. Change all from standing to SITTING WORKING AT A COMPUTER viewed FROM BEHIND, overhead angled down about 35degrees. Natural believable seated posture: torso gently forward, shoulders relaxed, elbows bent about90degrees, forearms reaching FORWARD toward an invisible keyboard in front of them (away from camera), hips seated, knees bent, lower legs descend below hips. We should see backs of their heads, shoulders, arms from above, shirt backs, hips and bent legs. NO chair, NO desk, NO computer, NO furniture: ONLY each seated person's body isolated, since existing furniture is already rendered in the game. Each subject centered in their own exact equal cell, complete head-to-feet with generous empty margins; shorter seated silhouette is intentional, do not elongate bodies. Preserve grid and1536x1024 canvas. Clean isolated cutouts on uniform pure white (#FFFFFF) background, no shadows outside figures, no ground. Camera and soft daylight consistent with realistic architectural office background. Detailed photographic garments and anatomically correct arms/hands. No cartoon, no text, no dividers.
